title: Design System: Pavlo Kostiuk — Owned E-commerce

display.purpose: The page headline only, at roll width, condensed 800 uppercase capped at 18ch.

headline.purpose: Section titles. The only level besides display allowed viewport-scale type.

title.purpose: Panel headings, group headings, plan steps, screenshot captions, form labels.

subhead.purpose: The single sentence under a headline, held to max-w-2xl.

body.purpose: All prose and list items at 1rem / 1.55; long-form explanatory prose loosens to 1.7.

figure.purpose: Stat and price values in tabular mono, red at page scale.

label.purpose: Navigation, locale codes, form input text, step numbers and list markers.

caption.purpose: Figure labels, footnotes, scarcity notes, copyright.

shadows.name: roll-curl
shadows.value: 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 6%, transparent), 0 18px 40px -28px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 55%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Applied by the roll surface itself so the paper reads as lifting off the page. Never applied to anything else.

shadows.name: label-lift
shadows.purpose: The price-gun label only; it is a physical sticker sitting proud of the roll.

motion.name: peel
motion.purpose: The price label straightening from -1.4deg and rising 2px on hover or focus-visible.

motion.name: ink-shift
motion.purpose: Link colour and field-underline colour changes. The only other motion in the system.

materials.name: roll
materials.value: background: var(--roll); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 6%, transparent), 0 18px 40px -28px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink) 55%, transparent);
materials.purpose: The paper every section is printed on.

materials.name: tear-bottom
materials.value: mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at 7px 7px, transparent 6px, #000 6.5px); mask-size: 14px 14px; mask-repeat: repeat-x; height: 14px;
materials.purpose: Perforated edge punched along the bottom of a roll surface.

materials.name: dotrule
materials.value: background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--ledger) 0 3px, transparent 3px 7px); background-size: 100% 1px; background-position: 0 50%;
materials.purpose: The dotted tear rule that divides every section.

materials.name: stamped
materials.value: font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.005em; line-height: 0.92; overflow-wrap: anywhere;
materials.purpose: The heading treatment. Applied by class, never re-declared per component.

components.name: Price Label (Primary CTA)
components.description: The fluorescent adhesive label — the only unprinted object on the roll. One per viewport.
components.html: BOOK A 20-MINUTE CALL↵
components.css: .ds-price-label { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--label, #ff5c1a); color: #14161a; padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 0; text-decoration: none; rotate: -1.4deg; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -16px rgba(20,22,26,0.9); transition: rotate 200ms ease-out, translate 200ms ease-out; } .ds-price-label__strip { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 6px; opacity: 0.6; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, #14161a 0 3px, transparent 3px 7px); } .ds-price-label__text { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Fira Sans Condensed'), sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.005em; line-height: 0.92; font-size: 1.25rem; } .ds-price-label__enter { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Roboto Mono'), monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-price-label:hover { rotate: 0deg; translate: 0 -2px; } .ds-price-label:focus-visible { rotate: 0deg; outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #d81f26); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Inline Red Link (Secondary Action)
components.description: The system's only secondary action: a red underlined text link. There is no filled secondary button.
components.html: Send me your product list instead
components.css: .ds-link-inline { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--primary, #d81f26); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-link-inline:hover { color: var(--brand-strong, #a8161c); } .ds-link-inline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #d81f26); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Paper Form Field
components.description: Underline-only field with mono input text; the underline turns thermal red on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; max-width: 32rem; } .ds-field__label { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Fira Sans Condensed'), sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.005em; line-height: 0.92; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink, #14161a); } .ds-field__input { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Roboto Mono'), monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.01em; width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #14161a); border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ledger, #8b979d); border-radius: 0; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 150ms; caret-color: var(--primary, #d81f26); } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color: var(--ledger, #8b979d); } .ds-field__input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: var(--primary, #d81f26); }

components.name: Locale Select
components.description: shadcn Select forced square and hairline: mono locale code, no shadow, red border on focus or open.
components.css: .ds-locale { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #14161a); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #c9d2d6); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Roboto Mono'), monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-locale:hover { border-color: var(--ledger, #8b979d); } .ds-locale:focus-visible, .ds-locale[data-state='open'] { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary, #d81f26); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; width: 100%; padding: 12px 24px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background, #eef1f2) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ledger, #8b979d); } .ds-nav__brand { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Fira Sans Condensed'), sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.005em; line-height: 0.92; font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--ink, #14161a); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav__group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-nav__link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Roboto Mono'), monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--ink-2, #3f4a50); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav__link:hover { color: var(--primary, #d81f26); } .ds-nav__cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--label, #ff5c1a); color: #14161a; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Fira Sans Condensed'), sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.005em; line-height: 0.92; font-size: 1rem; transition: translate 200ms ease-out; } .ds-nav__cta:hover { translate: 0 -2px; }

components.name: Roll Section with Tear Rule

components.html:
The counter and the site disagree

A customer buys the last one at the counter. The website sells it again ten minutes later.
components.css: .ds-roll { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 48px 24px; background: var(--roll, #fbfcfc); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink, #14161a) 6%, transparent), 0 18px 40px -28px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink, #14161a) 55%, transparent); } .ds-roll__title { font-family: var(--font-display, 'Fira Sans Condensed'), sans-serif; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.005em; line-height: 0.92; font-size: 3rem; color: var(--ink, #14161a); margin: 0 0 20px; max-width: 20ch; } .ds-roll__body { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--ink-2, #3f4a50); margin: 0; max-width: 42rem; } .ds-tear { height: 32px; width: 100%; background-color: var(--roll, #fbfcfc); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to right, var(--ledger, #8b979d) 0 3px, transparent 3px 7px); background-repeat: repeat-x; background-size: 100% 1px; background-position: 0 50%; }

narrative.overview:
The page is the artifact the counter prints. Every surface behaves like a continuous thermal receipt unspooling down the viewport: an unbroken roll of near-white stock, divided not by cards or containers but by perforated dot rules where the paper would tear. Content is stamped onto the roll rather than placed on top of it. There is no floating panel, no lifted card, no drop-shadowed hero — only what a two-colour printhead could physically put down: black at full density, thermal red for totals and voids, and a single unprinted object, the fluorescent price-gun label, stuck on at an angle.

The density is a printout's: full-bleed to the roll's edges with generous vertical silence between tear lines, columns separated by wide gutters and hairline rules instead of boxes. Type does the structural work. Heavy condensed caps are stamped at roll width for headlines; a quiet grotesque carries every sentence a human reads; monospace is reserved strictly for figures, codes and chrome — never for prose. The palette is cold, not warm: the paper is grey-blue thermal stock, never cream.

Two rejections are load-bearing and confirmed by the build. It refuses the centred hero-plus-screenshot arrangement the category ships — the first viewport is a left-weighted stamped headline with the product shot as a co-equal column, not a centred pitch above a device mock. And it refuses the warm-paper editorial ledger that preceded it here: no cream, no indigo, no system sans, no serif.
keyCharacteristics: Continuous roll, not stacked cards — sections are divided by perforation, not elevation
Zero corner radius on every authored surface; borders are hairlines, never heavy strokes
Exactly one unprinted element per screen: the fluorescent price-gun label CTA
Monospace is a figures-and-chrome material, never a body material
Full light and dark roll, with red brightening rather than the paper going warm
Diagrams carry meaning without labels: grey stroke is the broken present, red is the resolved future

rules.name: The One Unprinted Object Rule
rules.body: Price-gun orange is the only colour a thermal head cannot produce. It appears on primary actions only, at most once per viewport, and always with black type on it. If two orange objects are visible at once, one of them is not a primary action.

rules.name: The Cold Stock Rule
rules.body: The paper is grey-blue, never cream, ivory or warm white. Any neutral introduced must sit on the same cold axis as #eef1f2 / #fbfcfc.

rules.name: The Red Means Resolved Rule
rules.body: In every diagram, chart and step list, grey stroke is the broken present and red is the resolved future. Red is never decorative and never signals danger here — the destructive role is a separate token that the page does not use.

rules.name: The Figures-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Roboto Mono carries numbers, codes, step markers, list glyphs and interface chrome. It never sets a sentence a human reads. If a mono run exceeds a short phrase, it is the wrong font.

rules.name: The Stamped-or-Set Rule
rules.body: A heading is either stamped (condensed 800, uppercase, line-height 0.92) or it is plain body semibold. There is no third heading style, and Archivo is never set in caps.

rules.name: The Sixteen Rule
rules.body: Root size is exactly 16px and body line-height exactly 1.55. This is canonical, not inherited default — no surface may shrink base prose below 1rem.

rules.name: The Full-Bleed Roll Rule
rules.body: Sections span the full viewport width and paint their own background. Never wrap a section in a centred max-width container — the roll runs edge to edge or it is not a roll.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Box Rule
rules.body: Separation is achieved with a single hairline on one edge plus padding. Reach for a four-sided border only when the content is a genuinely inset panel (the prototype form, the audit transcript, a screenshot card).

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: The system has exactly two shadows and both are already assigned. Panels, cards, buttons, inputs, dropdowns and nav all carry box-shadow: none.

rules.name: The Motion-Is-Peel Rule
rules.body: The only motion in the system is a sticker responding to the cursor: a 200ms rotate-to-zero and a 2px rise on the label and its siblings, plus colour transitions on links and field underlines. Nothing fades in, nothing slides on scroll.

rules.name: The Square Corners Rule
rules.body: border-radius: 0 on every surface a user can touch. If a component library supplies a radius, override it.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every border in the system is 1px. 2px and heavier borders were deliberately removed from this build; reintroducing one is a regression, not a variant.

dos: Do paint every section as a full-bleed roll surface (roll white on the cooler page ground) and divide sections with the 32px dotted tear strip.
Do keep every corner square (0 radius) and every border one pixel, overriding any library default with rounded-none.
Do stamp headings in condensed 800 uppercase at line-height 0.92, and set all prose in Archivo at 1rem / 1.55.
Do reserve monospace for figures, step numbers, list markers, form input text and nav chrome.
Do limit fluorescent price-gun orange to one primary action per viewport, always with printhead-black type on it.
Do state the broken present in printhead grey and the resolved future in thermal red in every diagram.
Do define grid cells with a top hairline and 16px of padding rather than a box.
Do carry both the light and dark roll for any new surface; the paper darkens and the red brightens, but the palette never warms.
donts: Don't add a section eyebrow, kicker or overline above a heading. Sections open on the stamped headline and nothing else.
Don't reintroduce 2px or heavier borders; they were deliberately removed from this build.
Don't add a shadow to a panel, card, button, input or dropdown — the system's two shadows are already assigned to the roll and the label.
Don't set body prose, subheads or long copy in monospace.
Don't use warm neutrals (cream, ivory, warm white) or the predecessor's indigo; the stock is cold grey-blue.
Don't centre the hero or place a screenshot beneath a centred pitch; the first viewport is a left-weighted stamped headline with the shot as a co-equal column.
Don't use thermal red as a danger or error-only colour — it is the resolved/total colour and loses that meaning if it also means "wrong".
Don't wrap a section in a centred max-width container; cap the content inside it instead.
